word_synset_counts AS (\n  SELECT\n    s.wordid,\n    s.synsetid,\n    syn.domainid,\n    syn.posid,\n    COUNT(*) AS sense_count\n  FROM senses s\n  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid\n  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid\n),\nword_aggregates AS (\n  SELECT\n    wordid,\n    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,\n    SUM(sense_count) AS total_senses,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids\n  FROM word_synset_counts\n  GROUP BY wordid\n  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) >= 2\n),\ntop_synsets AS (\n  SELECT\n    wsc.wordid,\n    wsc.synsetid AS top_synsetid,\n    wsc.sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wsc.wordid ORDER BY wsc.sense_count DESC, wsc.synsetid ASC) AS rn\n  FROM word_synset_counts wsc\n  WHERE wsc.wordid IN (SELECT wordid FROM word_aggregates)\n)\nSELECT\n  w.wordid AS word_id,\n  w.word AS word,\n  wa.total_synsets,\n  wa.total_senses,\n  wa.distinct_domains,\n  wa.distinct_posids,\n  ts.top_synsetid,\n  ts.top_synset_sense_count\nFROM word_aggregates wa\nJOIN words w ON w.wordid = wa.wordid\nJOIN top_synsets ts ON ts.wordid = wa.wordid AND ts.rn = 1\nORDER BY\n  wa.total_senses DESC,\n  wa.total_synsets DESC,\n  wa.distinct_domains DESC,\n  w.wordid ASC\nLIMIT
